content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Ropar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Ropar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 is 14 September 2026. Ensure you apply well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Field Assistant position, candidates need to have a Bachelor's degree in Science or a 3-year Diploma in Engineering & Technology area from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant will receive a salary of Rs. 27000 + HRA as per norms per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application process for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. Does IIT Ropar offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here and should be confirmed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies announced by IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: IIT Ropar has announced a total of 4 vacancies for various posts including Junior Research Fellow, Field Assistant, and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Ropar (IIT Ropar).

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature, meaning they are offered on a temporary basis.
